provenance: Kinabalu Basin Geologist Dossier Fig. 8 + pp. 19, 25; forensic audit forge_work/2026-09-15-geox-sabah-mtjda-audit
purpose: Register the four competing deep-crustal hypotheses as falsifiable claims so a KT-7 depth-conversion result or an OBS refraction line lands against live claim records instead of prose.
test_status: ZERO TESTS RUN — all four hypotheses standing

claims.title: H1 — Deep crust beneath the Sabah accretionary wedge is Proto-SCS oceanic crust (ophiolitic remnant)
claims.statement: The deep crust beneath the NW Sabah accretionary wedge is a remnant of Proto-South China Sea oceanic lithosphere.
supporting: Lahad Datu ophiolites: N-MORB, low-K tholeiite (Barremian-Aptian)
Tomographic high-velocity anomaly in western Sabah upper mantle (Pilia et al., Gondwana Research 2023)
KT-6: Moho beneath NW Sabah 26-33 km — NON-KILL
Prior PSCS scorecard: 3 DIRECT + 4 CONSISTENT, 0 CONTRADICTED
claims.falsifier: Depth-converted KT-7 reflector with Vp OUTSIDE 5.0-6.5 km/s, or OBS line showing no ophiolitic Vp through the wedge.
claims.uncertainty_basis: Dossier published value INT 0.45 (p. 25, marked UNTESTED). Bands are C13-style brackets around a published point value, not a posterior.
claims.residual_ambiguity: Ophiolite Vp 5.0-6.5 km/s overlaps lower-crustal continental velocities at 12-21 km depth. KT-7 alone narrows H1-vs-H2; it does not kill H2.

claims.title: H2 — Deep crust is continental margin succeeded by a thrust detachment
claims.statement: The deep structure is a thrust detachment emplaced over a continental margin, with no significant oceanic crust in place.
supporting: Franke et al. 2008: 6-8 km reflector interpreted as a thrust detachment in the fold-thrust belt triangle zone
KT-6: Moho beneath NW Sabah is continental (26-33 km) — NON-KILL for a continental substrate
claims.falsifier: Depth-converted KT-7 or OBS Vp profile showing ophiolitic velocities through the wedge (Vp 5.0-6.5 km/s) with no detachment surface.
claims.uncertainty_basis: QUALITATIVE_ONLY. Dossier ranks H2 'moderate alignment' with no numeric value published. p50 is an a-priori bracket, NOT a derived estimate. Flagged for correction when a numeric ranking exists.
claims.residual_ambiguity: Shares its falsifier window with H1 — velocity overlap means one test may not separate them.

claims.title: H3 — Deep crust is rifted / volcanic continental basement
claims.statement: The deep crust is rifted continental basement with a significant volcanic (magmatic) addition.
supporting: No direct supporting dataset identified in the dossier evidence base
claims.falsifier: Reprocessed public magnetic and gravity data for offshore Sabah. A volcanic-continental signature can be killed or strengthened at near-zero cost. This was named the 6-month, modest-budget test.
claims.uncertainty_basis: QUALITATIVE_ONLY. Dossier ranks H3 'weakest alignment' with no numeric value published. p50 is an a-priori bracket, NOT a derived estimate.
claims.residual_ambiguity: Cheapest hypothesis to kill (public gravity/magnetics). Should be sequenced before any acquisition spend.

claims.title: H4 — Deep structure is shale-tectonic / gravity-driven collapse
claims.statement: The deep structure reflects shale tectonics and gravity-driven collapse rather than a primary crustal architecture.
supporting: NSPW is a mobile-shale-dominated wedge, 8-9 km thick over 75,000 km2 (Morley 2024)
Mobile shale overpressure documented across the wedge; mud canopy 1,900 km2 from ~50 centres
claims.falsifier: OBS refraction Vp profile penetrating below the mobile-shale interval to image primary crustal structure and Moho.
claims.uncertainty_basis: QUALITATIVE_ONLY. Dossier ranks H4 'moderate alignment' with no numeric value published. p50 is an a-priori bracket, NOT a derived estimate.
claims.residual_ambiguity: Mobile-shale low-velocity zones (Vp 1.5-2.0 km/s) will themselves contaminate any velocity-based discriminator. This hypothesis is the hardest to falsify with seismic velocity alone.

decision_tests.description: Depth-convert KT-7 reflector using existing velocity data
decision_tests.cost: Claimed zero; CONTESTED — federation code (sabah_prospect_discriminator.py) holds pscs_velocity_available=False and kt7_result=PENDING
decision_tests.geometry_dispute: Dossier: 12-21 km. Federation code (Franke et al. 2008): 6-8 km. UNRECONCILED.
decision_tests.discriminates: H1 vs H2 (partial). NOT all four — dossier overclaims.

decision_tests.description: Reprocess public magnetic + gravity datasets for offshore Sabah
~150 km wide-angle refraction line across the Sabah Trough with ocean-bottom seismometers
decision_tests.discriminates: Kills 3 of 4 simultaneously (dossier); cleanest stated discriminator

sequencing_doctrine: Information per dollar. Free first (KT-7, once velocity reconciled), then low cost (mag/grav reprocessing), then the USD 5-10M OBS line. Do NOT commission new deep-crustal 3D seismic before the free test has been run.
known_defects_attached: KT-7 geometry contradiction: 12-21 km (dossier) vs 6-8 km (federation code).
KT-7 velocity availability contradiction: dossier 'existing' vs code 'not published'.
H2/H3/H4 numeric bands are a-priori brackets, not published estimates — flagged in uncertainty_basis per claim.
Dossier citation metadata errors: Pilia journal (Nature Geoscience vs Gondwana Research); Madon DOI (230589 vs 230916).
